title: Negative vectors
description: Engineering consequence of QR Code Generation, 11. Verifying: the same steps upwards; HCERT Specification, 6.3 Input Data Validation.

statements.label: Negative vectors
statements.requirement: The shared vector set SHALL include failing cases with the expected failure reason for each: tampered payload, tampered protected header, wrong or unknown kid, duplicate kid with only the second DSC valid, a DER-encoded ES256 signature, expired, iat before the DSC validity, EKU mismatch, missing or unsupported prefix (HC2:), invalid Base45, decompression bomb, deeply nested CBOR, multiple subclaims, and a DVC without is or cn.

successCriteria.criterion: A test named after STT-TST-004 passes in each implementation's suite (Kotlin: `STT-TST-004 STT-TST-005 the shared negative vectors fail at the named step with the named reason` (ConformanceVectorsTest.kt)).
